items: In a large mixing bowl, cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Stir in bananas and sour cream.
Combine the flour, cinnamon, baking soda, and salt. Stir into banana mixture just until moistened.
Transfer to a greased 8x4x2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350°F for 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack to cool completely.
